verdict.rationale: CDP documents a webhooks product that sends real-time HTTP notifications for events across the integration, including wallet-activity subscriptions covering up to 100 addresses, so the core push model is there. The evidence does not show signature verification or the specific money-movement event types the story names. missing for 10: evidence that webhooks are signed/verifiable, documented payment-confirmed / payout-settled / conversion-executed event types, independent or hands-on corroboration.
